cases.name: Owned-order tracking
cases.expected: Resolved with authorized evidence; no action

cases.name: Eligible cancellation stops for approval

cases.name: Approver declines cancellation
cases.expected: Declined proposal escalates for human review; rejected receipt says order_changed false; no cancellation

cases.name: Unsupported refund request
cases.expected: Unsupported request escalates for human review; no proposal or action

actual.answer: This request is outside automated support. Please contact the support review team.

cases.name: Missing order information is attached to same case
cases.expected: needs_info; saving A-101 preserves case/customer/release and requires explicit resolution; second resolve succeeds
ui_steps: Enter Where is my order? without order

cases.name: Recoverable generation failure and explicit retry
cases.expected: Unavailable generation boundary saves failed case and error trace; after dependency repair an operator retries current case/version and resolves without action

failure.message: The response provider is temporarily unavailable. The case and trace were saved.

cases.error:
Failed case has a saved resolution object but the Resolution tab exposes no Retry resolution button

false !== true
